talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $82.3M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, up 513% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Elh Fund 1 LLC (Northville, Residential) targeting $50M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Gentherm Inc (THRM) closed a transaction. It was one of 4 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan manufacturing & automotive assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

4 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $92.5M raised so far — led by GEC Holdco LLC (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
